title: 2026 U.S. House election in Montana's 1st Congressional District
description: This is an open-seat race for Montana's 1st Congressional District, covering western Montana including Missoula, Bozeman, Butte, and Kalispell. Incumbent Republican Ryan Zinke announced his retirement on March 2, 2026, creating a competitive open-seat contest in a district with a Cook Partisan Voting Index of R+5. The Republican nominee is Aaron Flint, a conservative radio host and retired Army lieutenant colonel endorsed by President Donald Trump, who won the June 2 primary with 50.1% of the vote. The Democratic nominee is Sam Forstag, a smokejumper and union leader who won a competitive four-way primary with 37.4%; Libertarian Nick Sheedy also secured ballot access. The race is rated 'Likely Republican' by the Cook Political Report, though Democrats view the open seat as a pickup opportunity in a district that has been closely contested in recent cycles.
polling_note: No general election opinion polls have been released as of mid-June 2026. The primary elections were held on June 2, 2026. Public polls are expected to appear later in the campaign cycle.

candidates.name: Aaron Flint
candidates.summary: Aaron Flint is a Republican candidate for U.S. House in Montana's 1st Congressional District. A retired U.S. Army lieutenant colonel who served combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan and earned two Bronze Stars, Flint spent nearly a decade hosting the conservative talk radio program 'Montana Talks.' A fifth-generation Montanan and University of Montana graduate, he has been endorsed by President Donald Trump and won the Republican primary with 50.1% of the vote on June 2, 2026.

candidates.name: Sam Forstag
candidates.summary: Sam Forstag is a Democratic candidate for U.S. House in Montana's 1st Congressional District. A smokejumper (wildland firefighter who parachutes into remote wildfires) and union leader, Forstag is a Missoula resident who worked his way through the University of Montana. He is the nephew of U.S. Representative Susie Lee (NV-03) and won the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026, with 37.4% of the vote, edging out former gubernatorial nominee Ryan Busse.

candidates.name: Nick Sheedy
candidates.summary: Nick Sheedy is a Libertarian candidate for U.S. House in Montana's 1st Congressional District. He won the Libertarian primary unopposed on June 2, 2026, and advocates for constitutional governance, monetary reform including ending the Federal Reserve, limiting corporate influence in elections, and reducing federal regulatory burdens.

forecast.rationale: No general-election polling is available as of mid-June 2026, so this forecast is based on district fundamentals and carries higher uncertainty than a poll-driven assessment. Montana's 1st District has a Cook PVI of R+5 and is rated 'Likely Republican' by Cook Political Report. Republican nominee Aaron Flint, endorsed by President Trump, won a competitive primary with a clear majority (50.1%). Democrat Sam Forstag, a smokejumper and union leader, won a four-way primary with 37.4% and represents a credible challenge in an open-seat contest where the district has been closely contested in recent cycles. Libertarian Nick Sheedy is also on the ballot. With no public general-election surveys yet, the Republican advantage is clear but not overwhelming, tempered by the uncertainties of an open seat and a Democrat with a compelling local profile.
